import json, urllib.request
# positive test
for text in ['I love this movie, it was fantastic!', 'I hate this, it was terrible.']:
    req = urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:5000/sentiment', data=json.dumps({'text': text}).encode(), headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
        print(r.status, r.read().decode())
# error test: missing text
try:
    req = urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:5000/sentiment', data=json.dumps({}).encode(), headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
        print(r.status, r.read().decode())
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    print(e.code, e.read().decode())
